messages.text: Hello, just received my Hammer Thor P2 today. I absolutely love it! Just wanted to mention it came with the Thor OS firmware on it not the Harlo OS advertised on your website. I'm indifferent to which OS it has so not a deal with me just thought I'd mention it.
Handed to the team · Product listing / firmware mismatch, only Georges can correct a listing.

Glad it landed and that you're happy with it. Thanks for flagging the OS difference, that's genuinely useful. I've passed it to the team so they can check whether it's the listing or the firmware load that needs correcting, and they'll confirm by email. If you ever want to look at Harlo OS, the downloads and release notes live at https://harlolabs.com/.

One thing I'm curious about: what made you pick the Thor P2 over the smaller units?
Great price for 10 TH/s. Also it had great reviews on YouTube and online, and it's beautiful and really quite.

That's the Thor P2 exactly: 166 W at the wall for 10 TH/s, and quiet enough to sit in a room you use. Nice to hear the real-world verdict matches.

Where have you ended up putting it, desk or somewhere out of the way?

And I was happy to help. If you were pleased with us, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com. You're also welcome in our Discord for firmware chat and new releases: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

That's the right spot for it. Just leave a bit of air around the sides so the fan isn't pulling off a wall, and it'll stay quiet.

Enjoy it, and shout if anything comes up.
100% it's got room to breathe, thanks again have a great day!
Perfect. Happy hashing, and enjoy the rest of your day.
